issues.evidence_or_risk: client_credentials is documented for both tracks but absent from both discovery grant arrays.
issues.resolution: Verify the actual registered-client grant profile; do not remove documented M2M support based solely on generic metadata.

issues.evidence_or_risk: Documented IB invoice.read/invoice.history.read and allOrder.read are absent from observed metadata; production advertises allInvoice.read.
issues.resolution: Ask ABC for per-client, per-environment approved scope names. No inferred scope substitution.

issues.evidence_or_risk: TPA overview lists invoice REST features, but current invoice endpoint pages say unavailable to TPAs.
issues.resolution: Default-deny invoice REST for TPA until explicit provider confirmation.

issues.evidence_or_risk: ABC examples use Basic; Entra custom OIDC currently supports post/jwt and rejects Basic. ABC metadata advertises overlapping alternatives.
issues.resolution: Provision and test an Entra-compatible ABC federation client. Server advertisement is not client configuration.

issues.evidence_or_risk: OIDC and UserInfo are advertised, but no registered client was tested with openid/profile/email or claims.
issues.resolution: Obtain approved identity scopes and validate a real ID token/UserInfo response before treating ABC as an app sign-in provider.

issues.evidence_or_risk: An Entra-federated login does not establish a supported way for this backend to obtain ABC API refresh tokens.
issues.resolution: Keep the API connection broker separate; do not copy ABC tokens into Entra claims or directory attributes.

issues.evidence_or_risk: TPA guidance requires an active/present user for customer functionality while offering renewable tokens.
issues.resolution: Clarify allowed unattended/background actions, consent duration, offboarding and refresh use with ABC.

issues.evidence_or_risk: OAuth/API examples alone do not establish a stable user identity claim or ABC user-role claim for your client.
issues.resolution: Keep connection UUID separate from identity proof; verify issuer+sub through an approved OIDC/UserInfo profile when needed. Never match by email.

issues.evidence_or_risk: IB grant guide uses allOrder.read; individual Order pages say order.read.
issues.resolution: Verify all affected read endpoints with a provisioned IB client; retain integration-origin restrictions for TPA.

issues.evidence_or_risk: Revocation, logout and introspection endpoints are advertised; authentication requirements, permissions and effects were not exercised.
issues.resolution: Verify registered-client behavior and distinguish local disconnection from provider revocation and browser logout.

issues.evidence_or_risk: Docs describe renewable refresh tokens and returned replacement tokens, but race/reuse/grace and revocation semantics are not specified.
issues.resolution: Test serialized refresh, invalid_grant recovery and rotation loss; no infinite-lifetime promise.

issues.evidence_or_risk: Order-invoice event docs disagree about header secret vs payload apiKey.
issues.resolution: Validate separately from Entra sign-in. Do not accept unauthenticated events or guess an Entra bearer-token contract.

issues.evidence_or_risk: One External ID tenant can contain many contractor organizations.
issues.resolution: Use application customerOrgId plus membership/account ACLs; tid alone is not customer isolation.

issues.evidence_or_risk: Managed identity can access Azure resources but is not an ABC client credential.
issues.resolution: Use hosting managed identity for vault/store access; separately resolve the ABC registered-client credential.
